main.summary: Captured, explicit DataItem content fields for canonical integrity traversal.
main.remarks: The snapshot copies projection structure and references only. It is not a digest, does not recursively hash DataItems, and does not deep-copy referenced values.

property.name: Fields
property.summary: Ordinally keyed content-projection fields captured while the owning DataItem data gate is held.

field.name: ownedResources
field.summary: Disposable resources created while capturing this projection and released when the snapshot is disposed.

method.name: Dispose
method.summary: Release resources owned by the captured projection.
method.remarks: Attempts to dispose every owned resource. Throws AggregateException after the full attempt if one or more resources fail to dispose.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create an immutable, ordinally keyed content projection.
constructor.param: Explicit projection fields and their captured values.
Optional disposable resources created for this snapshot.

main.summary: A byte-array or stream-backed content value hashed by the canonical encoder.
main.remarks: The byte array or stream is retained by reference. Stream content is read incrementally; after successful hashing, a seekable stream is returned to position zero. Disposing the value disposes its stream, if any.

field.name: bytes
field.summary: The optional content buffer used when this value is byte-backed; null when it is stream-backed.

field.name: stream
field.summary: The optional source stream used when this value is stream-backed; null when it is byte-backed.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create a content value from an optional byte array and optional stream.
constructor.param: Content bytes; null when this value is not byte-backed.
Content stream; null when this value is not stream-backed.

method.name: ComputeDigest
method.summary: Compute a SHA-512 digest of the represented content.
method.param: Token checked between stream reads to cancel hashing.
method.remarks: Byte-backed content is hashed directly. Stream-backed content must be readable and is consumed from its current position; if seekable, its position is reset to zero only after a successful read to end. The rented working buffer is cleared and returned even if hashing fails or is canceled. A missing or unreadable stream causes InvalidOperationException.

method.name: Dispose
method.summary: Dispose the captured stream, if any.

method.name: FromBytes
method.summary: Create a content value backed by an optional byte array.

method.name: FromStream
method.summary: Create a content value backed by an optional stream.
